status: review-only; not wired into the build
editorial_target: Official-quality uncensored American English. Japanese meaning and established voice/register take priority over existing byte budgets.

records.TT1B/g0/r0: Made it… Devil Museum. I've been meaning to come here.
records.TT1B/g0/r1: When was the last time I saw a blue sky?
records.TT1B/g0/r5: There's a sign at the entrance.
records.TT1B/g0/r6: "CLOSED TODAY. If you need assistance, please go to the church."
records.TT1B/g0/r8: Me: Agh! My body's coming apart!
records.TT1B/g0/r12: I use the key and go inside.
records.TT1B/g0/r14: "Sabbath Box" — A box used at witches' gatherings in medieval Europe. Said to have held soul contracts made with devils.
records.TT1B/g0/r15: "Demon-Sealing Jar" — A legendary jar in which, thousands of years ago, the child of God is said to have imprisoned and sealed the Devil after a terrible battle.
records.TT1B/g0/r16: "Warding Bell" — A legendary bell said to have been used by the pharaohs of ancient Egypt to ward off evil. Its clear tone tore the Devil's eardrums.
records.TT1B/g0/r17: "Devil's Hand" — A bronze statue that became the symbol of a 19th-century American secret society devoted to Devil worship. Its razor-sharp claws tore the hearts from sacrificial victims.
records.TT1B/g0/r18: "Romani Talisman" — A star-shaped medal worn by nomadic Romani in the late 17th century to protect themselves from dangers on the road. A warding spell is engraved on it.
records.TT1B/g0/r19: It's huge in here… and damp.
records.TT1B/g0/r28: Me: Um… Girl: Have you seen everything? Me: Not yet…
records.TT1B/g0/r31: Me: You mean you're… Devil: I am what you might call… a devil. Me: G-g-g-gah! Devil: My patience in sending you telepathy all this time has finally paid off. Me: ........
records.TT1B/g1/r0: Devil: Being sealed away so long has left my body terribly frail. I'll be taking yours. Me: You can't just tell me that… Devil: There will be no debate.
records.TT1B/g1/r4: Girl: Eek! Me: Hold on to me!
records.TT1B/g1/r6: Maradul Barao Galdura! Maradul Barao Galdura! Maradul Barao Galdura!!
records.TT1B/g1/r10: Me: You've got beautiful eyes. Girl: Thanks.
records.TT1B/g1/r11: Me: You've got a nice nose. Girl: ........
records.TT1B/g1/r12: Me: Those are lucky earlobes. Girl: Pfft… You're funny. Me: Ha ha… Girl: Hee hee… She laughed! Me: What's your name? Girl: I'm…
records.TT1B/g1/r14: Me: You've got pretty big boobs… heh. Girl: Eek!
records.TT1B/g1/r17: She comes to for a moment… Girl: Aagh!
records.TT1B/g1/r20: Me: Gah! Devil: Whew… at last, I'm free!
records.TT1B/g1/r24: Me: W-wait! Man: I'll pay anything! P-please, just save me! Me: Listen… Man: Stay back! Aah!
records.TT1B/g1/r25: A huge map is spread out.
records.TT1B/g1/r26: Man: Pipe down! You're in the way!
records.TT1B/g1/r27: Man: I'm building a gigantic resort complex right here! It's the middle of nowhere now, but you just wait—this place'll be booming!
records.TT1B/g1/r28: Man: Money is everything! For enough of it, I'd sell my soul to the Devil!
records.TT1B/g1/r30: There's a nameplate and an intercom.
records.TT1B/g2/r0: …: Can I help you? Me: Oh, no. It's nothing…
records.TT1B/g2/r1: …: Can I help you? Me: It's about the museum…
records.TT1B/g2/r2: …: Ah, I see! I have something special that isn't on display at the museum. Please, come inside.
records.TT1B/g2/r5: …: I've lived in this house for forty years! I'm not leaving now! Me: I'm not some real-estate shark. …: Oh! I… I'm terribly sorry.
records.TT1B/g2/r7: …: Ah! That voice… It's you again. Please, come in.
records.TT1B/g2/r9: Elder: I painted this portrait of the Devil myself. I traveled the world, faithfully reconstructing the features I'd heard described in old accounts. My eyesight failed just before I finished it, so I was never able to put it on display…
records.TT1B/g2/r10: Me: Um… Elder: Ah! That voice…
records.TT1B/g2/r11: The parlor. There's a newspaper and a magnifying glass.
records.TT1B/g2/r12: "DR. SIMON VANISHES" — Last night, Dr. Simon, 84, announced a startling theory of time warp. Apparently, he disappeared to escape the media frenzy. Sources say his time machine is already complete, fueling rumors that Dr. Simon himself may have warped through time.
records.TT1B/g2/r13: He must use this to read the paper.
records.TT1B/g2/r15: No doubt about it. That's me… wearing some strange belt.
records.TT1B/g2/r17: Elder: A strange experience during the war changed my life. After that, I studied devil lore, collected legendary relics, and built this museum.
records.TT1B/g2/r18: Me: Um… about the key? Elder: Oh! Of course.
records.TT1B/g2/r19: I got the key. Elder: Take your time.
records.TT1B/g2/r20: Me: Did anyone come by? Elder: No, nobody…
records.TT1B/g2/r21: Me: Did anyone come by? Elder: Yes, just now. A rather loud man. He kept asking about Dr. Simon.
records.TT1B/g2/r22: Elder: Dr. Simon and I go back fifty years. Now, just between us… he's here. He has a secret villa in this town. Ah… I really do talk too much. There I go again…
records.TT1B/g2/r23: Me: Thanks for having me. Elder: Sorry I couldn't be a better host.
records.TT1B/g2/r24: Elder: Come now… stay a little longer.
records.TT1B/g2/r25: The trees are too dense to get through.
records.TT1B/g2/r28: Bet there are snakes in there.
records.TT1B/g2/r29: A map of the area. A villa lies to the north.
records.TT1B/g3/r1: Footprints lead deeper into the woods.
records.TT1B/g3/r6: Simon: M-monster! Me: No, listen! A devil forced us to switch bodies! Believe me! Simon: ........
records.TT1B/g3/r7: Simon: A young man burst in and stole my Time Belt…
records.TT1B/g3/r8: Me: The Time Belt? Simon: A belt-shaped time machine. I only just completed it. Me: … Simon: Go after him, or he'll warp away through time!
records.TT1B/g3/r9: Simon: Hurry! Go after him, or he'll warp away!
records.TT1B/g3/r10: Simon: Hey! Where are you going?
records.TT1B/g3/r11: A church way out here? That's odd.
records.TT1B/g3/r13: …: Aaaah! …: The Devil! Me: N-no! I'm not…
records.TT1B/g3/r16: He gives me a hard stare.
records.TT1B/g3/r19: People of all ages are here.
records.TT1B/g3/r20: Priest: May I help you? Me: No…
records.TT1B/g3/r21: Priest: May I help you? Me: The sign at the museum sent me here… Priest: I'm sorry. Get the key next door. My father has it.
records.TT1B/g3/r22: Priest: There aren't many, but every one is a rare treasure my father went to great lengths to collect. Please take your time.
records.TT1B/g3/r23: Priest: Lord, forgive our sins and the sins of our forefathers!
records.TT1B/g3/r24: Me: Excuse me… Member: Shh! We're in the middle of a hymn.
records.TT1B/g3/r25: Me: Excuse me… Member: Shh! We're in the middle of the sermon.
records.TT1B/g3/r26: Member 1: I've had a feeling of dread all morning, so I came here. Member 2: Me too. I couldn't sit still.
records.TT1B/g3/r27: Member: Listen to the priest. You'll feel better.
records.TT1B/g3/r29: Priest: A brave young man stood against the Devil and gave his life to save the child of God. With a gentle smile, he said, "It's over… Everything is back as it was…"
records.TT1B/g3/r30: Priest: Whenever the world fell into chaos, the Devil appeared. He preyed upon people's fear and plunged the world into darkness. And each time, people found the courage to drive him back. Before unwavering justice, evil must retreat.
records.TT1B/g3/r31: Devil: Well, well… my body's still unharmed. Me: G-g-give me my body back! Devil: I'm afraid not. I am about to embark on a long journey.
records.TT1B/g4/r0: Did I always look this mean?!
records.TT1B/g4/r2: Me: Where are you going? Devil: A little business. Me: What kind of business…? Devil: Why ask what you already know? Soul contracts, naturally.
records.TT1B/g4/r3: Devil: My worshipers call to me from every corner of the world. They await their savior. Me: … Devil: I must answer them as I travel through time.
records.TT1B/g4/r4: Devil: Farewell, then. Take good care of my body.
records.TT1B/g4/r6: Me: I-I'm being sucked in! Aaaah!
